<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  How it works: numbered or icon steps in a row or a column. Axes: layout (row, column), marker (number, icon),
  align, density, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Step } from "./steps-list.types";

  export type StepsListProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    steps: Step[];
    empty?: string;
    layout?: "row" | "column";
    marker?: "number" | "icon";
    align?: "start" | "center";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import IconBadge from "../compose/IconBadge.svelte";
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    steps,
    empty = "",
    layout = "row",
    marker = "number",
    align = "start",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: StepsListProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame
  id={id}
  title={title}
  tone={tone}
  density={density}
  align={align}
  measure={(((layout as string) === "row") ? "default" : "2xl")}
  landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
>
  {#if ((steps?.length ?? 0) === 0)}
    <EmptyState icon="list-ordered" title={empty} />
  {:else}
    <List
      tag="ol"
      class={cn("grid gap-6", (((layout as string) === "row") ? "sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4" : ""))}
      data-slot="items"
    >
      {#each steps as step, i (step.id)}
        <ListItem
          class={cn(
            "flex gap-4",
            (((layout as string) === "row") ? "flex-col" : ""),
            (((align as string) === "center") ? "items-center text-center" : "")
          )}
          data-slot="item"
        >
          <IconBadge variant="primary" data-slot="marker">
            {#if ((marker as string) === "icon")}
              <LucideIcon name={step.icon} size={20} />
            {:else}
              <Inline class="text-base font-bold">
                {((i + 1) == null ? undefined : String((i + 1)))}
              </Inline>
            {/if}
          </IconBadge>
          <Stack gap="2" align={(((align as string) === "center") ? "center" : "start")}>
            <Title as={3} size="xl" weight="bold">
              {step.title}
            </Title>
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {step.text}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
        </ListItem>
      {/each}
    </List>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
